primitives.meaning: an onboarding instance that is open and an activation event that has not been recorded
entryFilters: an onboarding instance is open for the account and activation is not yet recorded
the product's own record of setup milestones is readable
no nurture instance is already open for this onboarding instance

primitives.does: Read which setup milestones are complete and which remain, from the product's own record of what was done rather than from what was sent or opened

primitives.asks: Is there a critical next step still outstanding?

branches.label: A step remains
branches.test: at least one incomplete milestone stands between this account and value

branches.label: Nothing critical left
branches.test: the setup work is done and what remains is whether value has actually been produced

competition.precedence: below the authoritative activation event, which supersedes it wherever it sits

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the person is inside the product - the next step is best pointed at where it is taken
no active session, or the step needs an explanation that survives until the person returns

primitives.purpose: Surface the single most useful next action, read from the product's own record of what is done. Never a completed step, never the whole checklist.
primitives.brief: Surface the single most useful next action. A completed step is never suggested again, and an order is imposed only where one step genuinely depends on another - elsewhere the person picks
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

branches.label: Activated
branches.test: the authoritative activation event has been recorded

branches.label: Setup complete, value not yet produced
branches.test: every milestone is done and no activation event exists - the checklist finished and the product has still not done anything for them

cancelOn.meaning: the product's own record marks a setup milestone complete
the authoritative activation event for this onboarding is recorded

primitives.reads: the milestone record re-read from the product: which steps are complete, whether activation is recorded, whether the window is still open

branches.label: Activation
branches.test: the authoritative activation event was recorded

branches.label: A setup milestone
branches.test: progress was made but value has not been produced yet

primitives.asks: Is the same prerequisite actually blocking activation?

branches.label: A named blocker is holding it
branches.test: authoritative state shows one mandatory prerequisite unchanged and preventing activation, not merely a quiet interval

branches.label: No blocker; simply incomplete
branches.test: setup has not advanced but nothing identifiable is preventing it

primitives.on: one named mandatory prerequisite established as the thing preventing activation, rather than a general lack of progress
carries: the exact outstanding prerequisite and how long it has stayed unchanged
the onboarding route and the milestones already completed
suppresses: the generic next-step prompt for this prerequisite while the blocker journey owns it

primitives.asks: Is the onboarding window still open?

branches.label: Still open
branches.test: the window fixed at entry has not expired

branches.label: Closed
branches.test: the window has expired without activation

carries: what onboarding still had outstanding, so the right things get invalidated rather than all of them

primitives.reEntry: a later setup or activation event re-opens this normally; the completed milestones are kept, so a return does not start from the beginning
